# Story 01 — Staff authentication, sessions, password reset and own profile (Story: 496)

## Prerequisites

- Story 1.1 (repository scaffold, Laravel + Next monorepo) completed — verified by presence of `backend/` and `frontend/` roots in the repository tree.
- Story 1.3 (Sanctum baseline + `web` guard) completed — verified by `backend/config/sanctum.php` and the existing `web` guard in `backend/config/auth.php` lines 40–45.
- Coordinate with owners of the **Portal** module (`backend/app/Modules/Portal/`) before adding the `portal` guard so future portal-account work lands on the shared configuration.
- Audit log (Story 2.4) not yet available: the audit writes for sign-in success/failure required by the acceptance criteria are stubbed behind a `Log::channel('audit')` call in this story and swapped for the real writer when Story 2.4 lands. Document that TODO inline.

---

## Story Goal

Deliver secure staff authentication using **Laravel Sanctum in SPA cookie mode**, backed by a dedicated `web` guard for staff users and a **separate `portal` guard** for future portal accounts. Ship:

1. Cookie-session sign-in and sign-out for staff (`/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/logout`, `/api/auth/me`).
2. Configurable password policy (minimum length + complexity classes) enforced on sign-up-time flows and password change/reset.
3. Password reset via Laravel's built-in password broker (email link, hashed-at-rest, single-use, expiring).
4. Rate limiting on sign-in and reset-request endpoints.
5. `/profile` endpoints for the authenticated staff user to view and edit **name, password, and language preference** (`en` | `ar`).
6. Frontend sign-in, forgot-password, reset-password, and profile screens plus a session-expiry redirect to the sign-in route.
7. Audit-log hook for sign-in success/failure (stubbed until Story 2.4).

**Out of scope** (explicitly): two-factor enrolment/challenge, notification-preferences matrix on the profile, in-place re-authentication overlay (a plain redirect is used), the composer draft mechanics themselves (owned by Story 4.4; this story only guarantees the redirect does not clear `localStorage`).

## Product rules (from story)

**Current behaviour**

- Only the default Laravel scaffold `web` guard exists. No sign-in route is wired. Password reset table is present but has no controllers.
- There is no `portal_accounts` table; portal authentication has no separate identity space yet.
- The frontend has no auth screens; `app/page.tsx` renders a placeholder.

**New behaviour**

- **Two identity spaces, two guards, two cookies.** Staff use the `web` guard against `users`. Portal customers use a new `portal` guard against `portal_accounts`. A `users` credential must be **unresolvable** by the portal guard and vice-versa; a feature test proves this.
- **No `is_staff` column, no discriminator table.** Two physical tables, two Eloquent models under different modules.
- **Cookie-mode Sanctum.** No token issuance, no JS-visible credentials. `credentials: 'include'` on the frontend; CSRF via `/sanctum/csrf-cookie`.
- **Configurable password policy** in `config/auth.php` under a new `password_policy` key (min length, require upper, lower, digit, symbol; each toggleable). Enforced by a shared `App\Modules\Security\Rules\PasswordPolicy` rule class used by the register/reset/change requests.
- **Rate limits:** `login` = 5 attempts / minute per IP+email; `password-reset` = 3 requests / 10 minutes per IP+email. Excess returns a Problem Details `429`.
- **Session expiry** returns `401` with a `type=https://errors.example/session-expired` Problem Details body; the frontend intercepts, preserves the composer draft in `localStorage`, and redirects to `/sign-in`.
- **Audit hook:** on both success and failure, dispatch `App\Modules\Security\Events\StaffAuthAttempted { email, ip, userAgent, outcome }`. Listener writes to `Log::channel('audit')` for now; Story 2.4 will replace the listener.

### 2 — PortalAccount model and migration

**Create file:** `backend/app/Modules/Portal/Domain/PortalAccount.php`

```php
namespace App\Modules\Portal\Domain;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\User as Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Notifications\Notifiable;

final class PortalAccount extends Authenticatable
{
    use Notifiable;

    protected $table = 'portal_accounts';
    protected $guarded = ['id'];
    protected $hidden = ['password', 'remember_token'];
    protected $casts = ['email_verified_at' => 'datetime'];
}
```

### 7 — Controllers

Under `backend/app/Modules/Security/Http/Controllers/`, create:

- `AuthController.php` with `login(LoginRequest)`, `logout(Request)`, `me(Request)`, `session(Request)`. `login` calls `Auth::guard('web')->attempt([...], true)`, on success `regenerate` the session, dispatch `StaffAuthAttempted` (success) and return the current user shape. On failure dispatch (failure), return `ProblemDetails` with type `https://errors.example/invalid-credentials` and status `401`. `me` returns `id, name, email, preferred_locale, roles: []` (roles empty until Story 2.3). `session` returns `{ inactivity_minutes: config('auth.staff.inactivity_minutes'), expires_at: session()->get('_expires_at') }`.
- `PasswordResetController.php` with `sendResetLink(ForgotPasswordRequest)` (delegates to `Password::broker('users')->sendResetLink(...)`; always returns `202` regardless of user existence to prevent enumeration) and `reset(ResetPasswordRequest)` (delegates to `Password::broker('users')->reset(...)`; returns `204` on success, Problem Details `422` with token/expired/invalid mapping otherwise).
- `ProfileController.php` with `show(Request)`, `update(UpdateProfileRequest)`, `changePassword(ChangePasswordRequest)`.

All controllers extend `App\Http\Controllers\Controller` and return `JsonResponse` or throw `ProblemException` (`backend/app/Modules/Platform/Exceptions/ProblemException.php`) so `ProblemDetailsHandler` shapes the body. **Do not** emit ad-hoc error bodies — enforced by `tests/Architecture/NoControllerErrorBodiesTest.php`.

### 8 — Routes and rate limiters

**File:** `backend/routes/api.php`

Add a group scoped to Sanctum's stateful middleware:

```php
Route::middleware(['web', \Illuminate\Session\Middleware\StartSession::class])->group(function () {
    Route::post('/auth/login', [AuthController::class, 'login'])
        ->middleware('throttle:login')->name('auth.login');
    Route::post('/auth/logout', [AuthController::class, 'logout'])
        ->middleware('auth:web')->name('auth.logout');
    Route::get('/auth/me', [AuthController::class, 'me'])
        ->middleware('auth:web')->name('auth.me');
    Route::get('/auth/session', [AuthController::class, 'session'])->name('auth.session');

    Route::post('/auth/password/forgot', [PasswordResetController::class, 'sendResetLink'])
        ->middleware('throttle:password-reset')->name('auth.password.forgot');
    Route::post('/auth/password/reset', [PasswordResetController::class, 'reset'])
        ->middleware('throttle:password-reset')->name('auth.password.reset');

    Route::middleware('auth:web')->group(function () {
        Route::get('/profile', [ProfileController::class, 'show']);
        Route::patch('/profile', [ProfileController::class, 'update']);
        Route::post('/profile/password', [ProfileController::class, 'changePassword']);
    });
});
```

**File:** `backend/app/Modules/Security/SecurityServiceProvider.php`

- In `boot()`, register named limiters:

```php
RateLimiter::for('login', fn (Request $r) =>
    Limit::perMinute(5)->by(($r->input('email') ?? 'anon').'|'.$r->ip()));
RateLimiter::for('password-reset', fn (Request $r) =>
    Limit::perMinutes(10, 3)->by(($r->input('email') ?? 'anon').'|'.$r->ip()));
```

- Register event listener `StaffAuthAttempted → LogStaffAuthAttempt` (writes to `Log::channel('audit')`). Mark the listener with a `// TODO(Story 2.4): replace with AuditLog writer` comment.

- The `portal` guard is **registered but not routed** in this story. It exists so a feature test can assert `Auth::guard('portal')->getProvider()->retrieveByCredentials(['email' => $staffUser->email, 'password' => 'x'])` returns `null` when only a staff user exists (see Test Plan §4).

### 10 — Password broker verification

- Add a `MustVerifyEmail` no-op path: staff users are created by an administrator (Story 2.3), so this story does **not** implement self-registration. The broker still requires the user row to exist; if the email is unknown, the controller silently returns `202` to prevent enumeration.

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Unknown email on forgot-password** → controller returns `202` (no enumeration). Trigger enforced in `PasswordResetController::sendResetLink`.
- **Reused reset token** → Laravel broker returns `Password::INVALID_TOKEN`; controller maps to Problem Details `422` with type `password-reset-token-invalid`.
- **Expired reset token** → same mapping; broker checks `expire = 60` from `config/auth.php` line 99.
- **Rate-limit exhausted on sign-in** → `throttle:login` returns `429`; wrap through `ProblemDetailsHandler` so body is Problem Details, not the default Laravel `429`.
- **Portal credential used on staff login** → `Auth::guard('web')->attempt` returns `false` because the `portal_accounts` row is not in `users`. Test asserts.
- **Staff credential used on portal guard** → same, opposite direction. Test asserts.
- **Session expiry mid-request** → returns `401` with `session-expired` type; frontend listener triggers redirect (**does not** wipe `localStorage`).
- **Concurrent password change** — the change endpoint calls `session()->regenerate()` after success; other tabs see `401` on their next call and redirect.
- **Unicode in email** → validation uses Laravel's `email:rfc,dns`; accepts IDN.
- **Very long name** → 120-char cap in `UpdateProfileRequest`; longer inputs produce `422`.
- **Password contains the user's email local-part** → not enforced in this story; documented as a follow-up for Story 2.3.
- **Malformed `preferred_locale`** → `in:en,ar` rule rejects with `422`.
- **CSRF cookie missing** → Sanctum returns `419`; frontend `client.ts` retries once after calling `getCsrf()`.
- **Half-applied migrations** — running `01_...create_portal_accounts` without `02_...add_preferred_locale` still boots; the reverse also boots. Both are additive.

## Migration / Rollback

- **Apply order:** `2026_09_01_000100_create_portal_accounts_table` → `2026_09_01_000200_add_preferred_locale_to_users`. Both are additive; no data backfill needed. Existing rows in `users` get `preferred_locale = 'en'` by default.
- **Rollback:** each migration ships a `down()` that drops the added tables/columns. Rolling back leaves the `web` guard functional but removes portal isolation; the `portal` guard config remains in `config/auth.php` and will error if a request explicitly asks for it, so revert `config/auth.php` in the same rollback commit.
- **Half-applied state to test:** with only the portal migration applied and not the locale column, `GET /api/profile` should degrade gracefully by returning `preferred_locale: 'en'` from a null-coalescing accessor on `User`. Add that accessor even though the column is expected.

## Verification Steps

1. **Backend builds:** in `backend/`, `composer install && php artisan config:clear && php artisan migrate:fresh`.
2. **Backend tests:** `php artisan test --testsuite=Feature --filter=Security` and `php artisan test --testsuite=Architecture` (all pass, including `ModuleBoundariesTest`).
3. **Contract tests:** `php artisan test tests/Feature/Platform/OpenApiContractTest.php` to confirm the new `/api/auth/*` routes are documented (regenerate with `php artisan openapi:generate` if the drift check flags them).
4. **Frontend runs:** in `frontend/`, `pnpm install && pnpm dev`, visit `/sign-in`, sign in with a seeded user, verify redirect to `/`, verify `document.cookie` shows `laravel_session` and `XSRF-TOKEN` and does **not** contain any bearer token.
5. **Frontend tests:** `pnpm test --run` (all new tests pass; existing tests untouched).
6. **Lint / architecture:** `pnpm lint` in `frontend/`, `php artisan test tests/Architecture/NoControllerErrorBodiesTest.php` in `backend/`.
7. **Regression:** `curl -c cookies.txt http://localhost:8000/sanctum/csrf-cookie` then `curl -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -H "X-XSRF-TOKEN: <token>" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"admin@example.com","password":"…"}' http://localhost:8000/api/auth/login`; expect `200`.
8. **Regression:** repeat the login curl 6 times in one minute; the 6th response is `429` with Problem Details.
9. **Regression:** log the response of `GET /api/auth/me` and grep for `password` — must be empty.

## Done Criteria

- [x] Staff can sign in with email + password over Sanctum cookie mode; session cookie and CSRF cookie present, no JS-accessible credential.
- [x] `web` and `portal` guards both registered; feature test proves credentials do not cross the boundary.
- [x] `config/auth.php` exposes `password_policy` and `staff.inactivity_minutes`; both are read via `config()` (no hard-coded values in controllers).
- [x] Password reset works end-to-end via Laravel's password broker; tokens are single-use, expiring, hashed at rest.
- [x] `login` and `password-reset` endpoints are rate-limited by named limiters; excess returns Problem Details `429`.
- [x] Passwords are never returned in any response body and never written to any log (assertion test in place).
- [x] `/api/profile` GET/PATCH and `/api/profile/password` POST work; name, password, and `preferred_locale` (`en` | `ar`) are editable.
- [x] Session expiry returns `401 session-expired`; frontend redirects to `/sign-in?redirect=…` **without** clearing `localStorage`.
- [x] Sign-in success and failure both dispatch `StaffAuthAttempted`; a stub listener writes to the audit log channel with a TODO for Story 2.4.
- [x] Migrations run cleanly forward and backward on a fresh database.
- [x] `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`, `php artisan test` all green.
